note: The kinds of behaviour a world thing may have (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §2.1, §3.3): append only, an entry's index is its number. Each has exactly one handler in Hollow.Simulation (Capabilities/), and the zone refuses to start while one lacks it or a handler names none. Which things have which is said by their own data, in the blocks each note names; what a capability tells a player about a thing is its share of the thing's viewer flags.

capabilities.note: Placed or built by a player: every deployable (deployables.json), a door and its lock, the claim device, a ship, an explosive. Mine for its owner (a door's: its lock's fitter, if it has a lock), Teammate for their team.
Holds items: deployables.json slots, world props, bags of dropped items, bodies, a ship's cargo. Empty while it holds nothing.
Burns fuel: deployables.json device (the campfire, the furnace). Lit while it burns.
Works on what is in it: deployables.json recycler and research (the recycler, the research table). Lit while at work.
Opens and shuts: building.json doors. CanUse when the viewer may pass it now.
items.json building KeyLock, fitted to a door. Locked.
items.json building CodeLock, fitted to a door. Locked; HasCode once a code is set; Authorised when the viewer is on its list.
building.json claim: a base's building rights and upkeep. Authorised when the viewer is on its list.
ships.json. Locked when its owner locked it.

Goes after a while, on world time, by the zone's one lifetime step (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §3.7): survival.json lifetimes (bags of dropped items, bodies, a dud), animals.json corpse (an animal's carcass). At once when emptied, if its rule says so.
explosives.json throwables: a charge or grenade with its fuse. Stuck to or lying on a thing, it falls when that goes (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §3.6).

Placed on something that may go (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §6): every deployable (deployables.json). Standing on a foundation or floor, it goes when that goes (Rust): it breaks and what it held spills in one bag. Nothing for a viewer.
Taken whole with E (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §5): gather.json's pickups and berry bushes (a bush is picked bare and stays), bags of dropped items (all that fits), spent arrows.
deployables.json pickup: an emptied deployable is picked back up as its item where the viewer has building rights (Rust's).
deployables.json workbench: its tech tree, opened with E, and the tree's unlocks (world.json trees).
A player down (the wounded state): another helps them up.
A player awake: the leader of a team invites them into it.
An explosive whose fuse went out: anyone lights it again.
A spent arrow stuck where it hit (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §5), held by what it hit: when that goes it falls to the ground below.

A fire a blast left (explosives.json fires, IW4, IRON_WAKE.md §7), held by what it burns on: when that goes, the burning fuel falls to what is below and burns on, or goes out with nothing near enough below.
